title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — September 19, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C3.3 (Peaked September 19, 2026 at 18:17 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 402 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Things are pretty calm. 🌞🤍

A broad coronal-hole region is visible on today’s solar disk, while no clear sunspots or major outward structure stand out.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 284 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
